mapper.select: SELECT v.*, ind.code AS ind_code, ind.name AS ind_name, mfd.field_key AS mfd_field_key, mfd.field_name AS mfd_field_name FROM apms_test_result_value v LEFT JOIN apms_indicator ind ON v.indicator_id = ind.id LEFT JOIN apms_test_model_field mfd ON v.field_id = mfd.id WHERE v.id = #{id}

SELECT v.*, ind.code AS ind_code, ind.name AS ind_name, mfd.field_key AS mfd_field_key, mfd.field_name AS mfd_field_name FROM apms_test_result_value v LEFT JOIN apms_indicator ind ON v.indicator_id = ind.id LEFT JOIN apms_test_model_field mfd ON v.field_id = mfd.id WHERE v.result_id = #{resultId} ORDER BY v.field_id, v.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO apms_test_result_value (result_id, indicator_id, model_id, field_id, field_key, field_name, numeric_value, text_value, unit, is_derived, algorithm_id, algorithm_version) VALUES (#{resultId}, #{indicatorId}, #{modelId}, #{fieldId}, #{fieldKey}, #{fieldName}, #{numericValue}, #{textValue}, #{unit}, #{isDerived}, #{algorithmId}, #{algorithmVersion})

INSERT INTO apms_test_result_value (result_id, indicator_id, model_id, field_id, field_key, field_name, numeric_value, text_value, unit, is_derived) VALUES
(#{v.resultId}, #{v.indicatorId}, #{v.modelId}, #{v.fieldId}, #{v.fieldKey}, #{v.fieldName}, #{v.numericValue}, #{v.textValue}, #{v.unit}, #{v.isDerived})
